Name: AutoBowl
Author: Stitch1959
Description:
[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
Keeps every pet bowl filled and the slime hutch troughs watered, and tells you when something is wrong instead of letting a pet lose its daily friendship in silence.

[b]WHAT IT DOES[/b]
• Every pet bowl on the farm is filled at the start of each day, in every location, including the island farm.
• The four water troughs inside the slime hutch are filled too, so slimes keep producing slime balls without hand watering.
• An optional hotkey fills bowls and troughs on demand.
• An optional popup reports the morning refill, instead of a badge sitting on screen all day.
• Filling on save load is optional as well.

[b]CHECKS FOR SILENT FAILURES[/b]
A pet only drinks from the bowl assigned to it, and it has to be able to reach that bowl. Vanilla tells you nothing in either case.

• No pet bowl, a pet without a bowl never drinks and silently loses that day's friendship. The mod names the pet.
• Bowl has no pet, a bowl nobody is assigned to is decoration, and the mod points it out.
• Bowl is blocked, if water, a solid object or another building occupies the tile below the bowl, the pet cannot drink and the mod says so.

[b]INSTALL[/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended: without it you have to edit config.json by hand.

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change any of these in game.

• Auto fill, also fill when loading a save, fill the slime hutch troughs.
• Skip on rainy days, off by default. Vanilla fills the bowls when it rains, but leave this off if another mod clears them every day.
• Refill hotkey, default F6. Set it to None to disable.
• Popup after the refill, console log, warnings about missing and unusable bowls.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
• Moving pet bowls, the mod never caches a bowl reference, it rescans every morning, so a relocated bowl keeps being filled.
• Multiplayer, only the host writes the bowl, so nothing desyncs. The hotkey is ignored on farmhands and while a menu is open.
• Save data, no custom save data is stored, so you can remove the mod at any time.
• Languages, English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

REQUIREMENTS
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later, tested with 4.5.2, game version 1.6.15.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
